what_to_detect: A blockers record in which a potential blocker with greater power than the anchored attacker, that attacker being its controller's Ring-bearer, is listed as forbidden by The Ring's CantBlockBy static. Why no family fits: The Ring is an engine-built effect card (Player.createTheRing/setRingLevel) with no script file, so ProvenanceResolver keys its traits to no line (ability_unresolved engine_effect): the forbidden entry's responsible_static is empty, the same as for a blocker the rules themselves forbid (a tapped one), so responsible_static true excludes it and false matches every forbidden blocker. Needs the record to name an engine-built static's script mode.
near_miss: A blockers record for a Ring-bearer attacker in which a potential blocker with power not greater than the attacker's is on the legal blockers list.

what_to_detect: The Ring's level-2 trigger (Mode$ Attacks, ValidCard$ Card.YouCtrl+IsRingbearer) is evaluated and fires when its controller's Ring-bearer attacks. Why no family fits: The Ring is an engine-built effect card (Player.createTheRing/setRingLevel) with no script file, so ProvenanceResolver keys its traits to no line (ability_unresolved engine_effect), so trigger_mode, which reads Mode$ off the acting line, cannot see these triggers; a declaration giving only the mode would instead tag every printed trigger of that mode.
near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated against an attack and does not fire (the attacker is not the Ring-bearer).

what_to_detect: The Ring's level-3 trigger (Mode$ AttackerBlockedByCreature, ValidCard$ Card.YouCtrl+IsRingbearer) is evaluated and fires when its controller's Ring-bearer becomes blocked by a creature. Why no family fits: The Ring is an engine-built effect card (Player.createTheRing/setRingLevel) with no script file, so ProvenanceResolver keys its traits to no line (ability_unresolved engine_effect), so trigger_mode, which reads Mode$ off the acting line, cannot see these triggers; a declaration giving only the mode would instead tag every printed trigger of that mode.
near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated against a block and does not fire (the blocked attacker is not the Ring-bearer).

what_to_detect: The Ring's level-4 trigger (Mode$ DamageDone, ValidSource$ Card.YouCtrl+IsRingbearer, CombatDamage$ True) is evaluated and fires when its controller's Ring-bearer deals combat damage to a player. Why no family fits: The Ring is an engine-built effect card (Player.createTheRing/setRingLevel) with no script file, so ProvenanceResolver keys its traits to no line (ability_unresolved engine_effect), so trigger_mode, which reads Mode$ off the acting line, cannot see these triggers; a declaration giving only the mode would instead tag every printed trigger of that mode.
near_miss: The same trigger is evaluated against damage dealt and does not fire (the source is not the Ring-bearer, or the damage is not combat damage to a player).
